storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/spaceweather/ — four prefixed series per day: kp-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (observed planetary Kp), alerts-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (SWPC alert messages), conditions-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (per-poll composite snapshot), xray-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (GOES X-ray flux, both energy bands); gz after 2 days
source: NOAA SWPC services.swpc.noaa.gov: products/noaa-planetary-k-index.json, products/noaa-scales.json, products/alerts.json, products/summary/solar-wind-{speed,mag-field}.json, json/ovation_aurora_latest.json, json/goes/primary/xrays-1-day.json
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'NOAA SWPC'. Keyless.

field_map.kp-*: t: 3-hour bin start (UTC) — dedup key for the Kp series
field_map.kp-*: kp: planetary Kp (PRELIMINARY estimate; definitive Kp posts later — never relabeled here)
field_map.kp-*: a/n: a_running index / contributing station count as published
field_map.alerts-*: id: product_id + issue_datetime (dedup key — messages are immutable)
field_map.alerts-*: code/serial/title: extracted from the message text (Space Weather Message Code / Serial Number / first ALERT|WARNING|WATCH|SUMMARY line)
field_map.alerts-*: message: full message text, truncated to 2000 chars
field_map.conditions-*: id: composite of upstream stamps (Kp bin + scales stamp + wind time_tags + ovation obs) — dedup key; one row per distinct upstream state
field_map.conditions-*: kp/r/s/g: latest observed Kp + current R/S/G scales at poll time
field_map.conditions-*: windKms/btNt/bzNt: solar-wind speed / IMF Bt / Bz summary readings
field_map.conditions-*: auroraMax/auroraObs: OVATION grid max probability (%) + model observation time — a SUMMARY; the ~900 KB forecast raster is never archived
field_map.xray-*: time_tag|energy: GOES observation timestamp + energy band (0.05-0.4nm short / 0.1-0.8nm long) — composite dedup key, two bands share a time_tag
field_map.xray-*: flux: W/m^2 as published; the API layer classifies the long band into NOAA's own published A/B/C/M/X flare-class formula (not stored pre-classified — classification is applied at serve time so a formula fix never needs a backfill)
field_map.xray-*: electronContamination: NOAA's own per-reading contamination flag (normalized from their upstream field's misspelling), null if absent

confidence_model: RAW official NOAA readings plus NOAA's OWN model forecast, labeled per row and never blended: Kp/scales-current/solar-wind/alerts/X-ray-flux are observations as published (Kp preliminary); ovation aurora and scales-forecast rows are NOAA forecasts and are always served/labeled as forecasts. X-ray flare class is NOAA's own published classification formula applied to the observed flux, not a fit of ours. No derived quantities of ours anywhere in the stream. The grid/utility trading hypothesis (Kp/G spikes -> DOE OE-417 disturbance reports -> exposed-utility moves) is ladder-gated in open_questions.md — this archive IS the gate-1 evidence base, not a validated signal.
cadence: 10-min poll; Kp advances 3-hourly, ovation ~5-min upstream, alerts as issued, X-ray flux ~1-min upstream (sampled at poll cadence, not every upstream tick)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). open_questions.md SPACE WEATHER hypothesis, gate-1 archiver + RAW /data display layer (aurora oval + conditions card).
